list_calls.title: List calls
list_calls.description: List the organization's recorded meetings and calls (all members), newest first, with metadata, summaries and delivery state. Filter by keyword, contact, CRM record, time range or delivery status. Use get_call for one call's full detail and get_call_transcript for the transcript.

keyword.description: Search call title, participant name and CRM record name.

start_timestamp.description: Only calls starting at or after this time, Unix milliseconds.

end_timestamp.description: Only calls ending at or before this time, Unix milliseconds.

delivery_completed.description: Only calls whose CRM delivery completed.

delivery_failed.description: Only calls whose CRM delivery failed.

delivery_not_sent.description: Only calls not yet delivered to the CRM.

record_name.description: Only calls linked to this CRM record name.

get_call.title: Get a call
get_call.description: Get one call's full record: status, metadata (title, participants, times), note, highlights, summaries, analyses and transcript chunks.

call_id.description: Id of the call (_id from list_calls).

get_call_transcript.title: Get a call transcript
get_call_transcript.description: Get a call's transcript as chunks, each with speaker, start and end time and text. Use get_call for summaries and metadata.

get_job.title: Get a processing job
get_job.description: Get a processing job (e.g. transcription or summarization of an uploaded recording) by id: type, status, fail reason, the call it belongs to and timing.
